text:
maria: Heads-up: Helio Bank pilot ask — 3-week POC for customer support automation + policy-aware reply generator. Need prompt inventory + baseline evals. Can SEs draft by Fri? @alex

alex: On it. Quick Q: do they need redaction + PII detection in prompts, or will we call their service?

maria: They want redaction in-path. Compliance requires no raw PANs in logs. Dave from security will confirm controls.

dave: Security note: we need to capture requirement for KMS + no token logging. Also SQ asks about data residency. Can you list sample prompts and expected outputs?

sam: I'll run baseline evals. Need 20 representative prompts per intent. Proposed intents: 'triage ticket', 'suggest reply', 'regulatory-summary'.

maria: Yes. Also success criteria: latency < 250ms p95 for 1rps, F1 > 0.85 on intent mapping, hallucination rate < 2% on sampled evals.

alex: Ack. I'll assemble inventory. Example prompt for 'suggest reply':
```
User message: "My card was charged twice"
System: "You are a support assistant. Provide brief empathetic reply and next steps. Don't expose PII."
```
Baseline model: open-llm-3-small (quantized).

sam: I'll run eval harness with 100 seed examples and metric configs. What about routing? They want fallback to smaller model on spike.

maria: Pricing Q from procurement: What's estimated token cost for 100k monthly messages? Need a ballpark to escalate to pricing team.

alex: Rough calc: avg 120 tokens per convo => 12M tokens/month. With hosted rate $0.0006/token => ~$7.2k/mo. Include 10% buffer + dedicated burst pricing.

dave: For the security questionnaire answer: note private deployment option available + HSM/KMS integration. I'll draft the SQ snippets if you send inventory.

alex: Sending initial inventory in #drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/helio/pilot-prompts (private).

maria: :thumbsup: timeline: inventory + baseline prompts by Fri, evals run by Mon, initial results + pricing for Tue exec sync. Any blockers?

sam: One: need anonymized sample dataset from Helio. Two: clarify SLA for model rollouts (can we do canary?).

maria: I'll request anonymized dataset in today's follow-up. Canary deploy okay per product, will note in spec.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create POC-ticket in JIRA - Redwood-POC-4721 assigned to alex, sam.

maria: Thanks all. I'll collate and send action items.
